Metadata.roomDescription: Join room {id} to play Dots online.

Index.title: Play Dots Online
Index.subtitle: The classic territorial strategy game. Enclose your opponent's dots to capture them. Play with friends instantly—no sign up required.
Index.objectiveText: Surround enemy dots with a continuous line of your own dots to capture them.
Index.placementText: Players take turns placing a single dot on an empty grid intersection.
Index.capturingText: To capture, form a closed polygon of your dots that encloses at least one enemy dot. Empty spaces inside the polygon are allowed.
Index.winningText: The game ends when no more valid moves can be made or players agree to stop. The player with the most captured enemy dots wins.

Lobby.joinDescription: Enter a room ID to join an existing game
Lobby.createDescription: Start a new game and invite a friend

GameRoom.surrenderConfirm: Are you sure you want to surrender?
GameRoom.directTouchDesc: Tap directly on intersections to place dots. (Default)
GameRoom.dragReleaseDesc: Touch and hold to aim, release to place. Avoids fat-fingering.
